Privacy Notice

Last updated 13 October 2026

Privacy NoticeWebsite TermsCookie Policy

1. Introduction

Welcome to Go Technologies.

At Go Technologies ("Go Technologies", "we", "us", or "our"), we respect your privacy and are committed to handling your personal information responsibly, transparently, and securely.

This Privacy Notice explains how we collect, use, store, disclose, and protect personal information when you visit our corporate website, contact us, or express interest in our products, services, or business partnerships.

We operate from Sri Lanka and aim to follow applicable data protection requirements, including Sri Lanka's Personal Data Protection Act No. 9 of 2022, as amended, to the extent its relevant provisions are in force.

2. Scope of This Notice

This Privacy Notice applies to information processed through the Go Technologies corporate website at https://gotechnologies.lk and any related corporate communications covered by this notice.

It does not automatically govern the separate websites, applications, or services of products developed by Go Technologies, including GoChauffeur. Those products may have their own privacy notices describing their specific data practices.

3. Information We Collect

Depending on how you interact with our website, we may collect the following categories of information.

Information You Provide

  • Name and contact details, including email address and phone number.
  • Company or organisation name, professional role, and business information.
  • Information submitted through contact forms, partnership inquiries, or email communications.
  • Other information you voluntarily provide when communicating with us.

Information Collected Automatically

When you visit our website, certain technical information may be collected, including:

  • Internet Protocol (IP) address.
  • Browser type, device type, and operating system.
  • Pages visited, approximate visit duration, and referral sources.
  • Website performance and technical diagnostic information.
  • Cookie identifiers and related information, where applicable.

The information collected depends on the technologies and services enabled on our website.

4. How We Use Your Information

We process personal information for purposes including:

  • Responding to inquiries and communicating with visitors.
  • Evaluating and managing potential partnerships and business relationships.
  • Providing information about Go Technologies and our products.
  • Operating, maintaining, and improving our website.
  • Understanding website usage and performance.
  • Detecting, preventing, and addressing security threats or misuse.
  • Complying with applicable laws and lawful requests.
  • Sending business or product updates where you have requested or otherwise lawfully agreed to receive them.

We will not use your personal information for purposes incompatible with those communicated to you unless permitted or required by applicable law.

5. Legal Basis for Processing

Where required by applicable law, we process personal data on an appropriate legal basis, which may include:

  • Your consent.
  • Taking steps at your request before entering into an agreement or performing an agreement with you.
  • Compliance with applicable legal obligations.
  • Legitimate interests recognised under applicable law, subject to applicable safeguards and limitations.

The applicable basis depends on the purpose and circumstances of the processing.

Where consent is required, you may withdraw it through the available means, without affecting processing lawfully carried out before withdrawal.

6. Sharing of Personal Information

We do not sell personal information to third parties.

We may share relevant personal information with:

  • Website hosting, infrastructure, and technical service providers.
  • Communication, email, and customer inquiry management providers.
  • Website analytics providers, where enabled.
  • Professional advisers acting under appropriate confidentiality obligations.
  • Government authorities or regulatory bodies where legally required.
  • Other parties where you have authorised the disclosure or where another lawful basis applies.

We limit such disclosures to information reasonably necessary for the relevant purpose and apply appropriate safeguards.

7. International Data Transfers

Some service providers supporting our website or communications may process information outside Sri Lanka.

Where personal information is transferred internationally, we will take appropriate steps to comply with applicable data protection requirements and protect the information through suitable contractual, organisational, or technical safeguards.

8. Data Retention

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, including legitimate business, security, and legal requirements.

Retention periods may vary depending on the nature of the information, the purpose of processing, and applicable legal obligations.

When information is no longer required, we will take reasonable steps to delete, anonymise, or securely dispose of it.

9. Data Security

We take reasonable technical and organisational measures designed to protect personal information against unauthorised access, loss, misuse, alteration, and disclosure.

However, no internet-based service or electronic storage system can guarantee absolute security.

10. Your Privacy Rights

Subject to applicable law, you may have rights relating to your personal information, including the right to:

  • Request access to personal data we hold about you.
  • Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.
  • Request erasure of personal information in applicable circumstances.
  • Withdraw consent where processing relies on consent.
  • Object to certain processing activities where applicable.
  • Exercise other rights available under applicable data protection law.

To submit a privacy-related request, please contact us using the details provided below.

We may request reasonable information to verify your identity before processing certain requests.

You may also have the right to raise a complaint with the relevant data protection authority where applicable.

11. Cookies and Analytics

Our website may use cookies or similar technologies to support essential website functionality, maintain security, and understand how visitors interact with our content.

For further information, please review our separate Cookie Policy.

Where applicable law requires consent for particular technologies, we will seek it before enabling them.

12. Third-Party Websites

Our website may contain links to third-party websites, including GoChauffeur and other external services.

We are not responsible for the privacy practices of independently operated third-party websites. We encourage visitors to review their respective privacy notices.

13. Children's Privacy

Our corporate website is intended for a general business and adult audience and is not specifically directed towards children.

We do not knowingly seek to collect personal information from children through this corporate website.

If you believe that a child has provided personal information to us inappropriately, please contact us so that we can review the matter.

14. Updates to This Notice

We may update this Privacy Notice periodically to reflect changes in our operations, website technologies, or applicable legal requirements.

The latest version will be published on this website with its updated effective date.
